name: Protagonist
source:
The protagonist was laid off from a major advertising agency and now working at a pub called "Shanti".

He was serious and enthusiastic about his work. However, after overworking to the point of breaking down and being dismissed, he lost his motivation and became indifferent to life. An encounter with Mai begins to change him.

[Translated from the [url=https://sakuramint01.kagennotuki.com/tsukiteras/tsuki_chara.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
The protagonist was laid off from a major advertising agency and now working at a pub called "Shanti".

He was serious and enthusiastic about his work. However, after overworking to the point of breaking down and being dismissed, he lost his motivation and became indifferent to life. An encounter with Mai begins to change him.
